sentences.text: Truncation from N to M is induced by the inclusion of the extension of dimension M into that of dimension N, with the domain:
v zero equals its M source, which keeps only the M cells.
It interprets the sources, targets and compositions of the dimensions from M up to N by a variable, and the domain conditions alone make two cells composable only when they are equal.
These two functors are not inverse to each other, since truncation forgets the higher cells.
a homomorphism from a discretized algebra to an N dimensional algebra is the same as a homomorphism into its truncation.
So discretization is left adjoint to truncation, and truncating what was just discretized changes nothing.
The same holds in the heterogeneous presentation.
